scientific_integrity: Claim includes the identity in the order-dividing-two count; the exact-order-two count subtracts one. The proof gives all primes and exponents, checked computationally for finite samples only.
scientific_limitations: Unequal cyclic exponents only, rank two; no enumeration of conjugacy classes, fixed-point strata, or equal-exponent cases. Originality remains subject to unindexed general modular-involution classification; finite checker is not an infinite proof.
title: Involutive automorphisms of two unequal cyclic prime-power groups: a sharp exponent-gap law
